plan.archetype: Flexible poison defense with immediate damage and AoE
plan.bossPrep: Bring efficient AoE, sustained poison, improved block, and useful potions. Remove the curse early; enter with enough HP for a prolonged fight.
plan.summary: Use the gold at an early shop. Add immediate damage before slow scaling, then poison and efficient defense. Upgrade core cards when safe; avoid unsupported combo pieces.

plan.archetype: AoE and sustained damage backed by weakness and efficient defense
plan.bossPrep: Recover HP, improve Echoing Slash when safe, add sustained damage and group weakness, and stock combat potions. Eliminate followers before their strength overwhelms defense.
plan.summary: Recover and avoid optional elites. Existing block density is sufficient; prioritize immediate AoE and sustained damage. Spend shop gold on impactful damage or survival potions before marginal removals. Upgrade Echoing Slash only with adequate HP.
